subheading: SPIRITUALITY: BASIC CONCEPT AND ITS NON-CHRISTIAN UNDERSTANDINGS
english: In this first chapter, we discuss two topics: (a) the basic concept of spirituality (b) its understanding in four selected non-Christian religious traditions.
